title: Build a 30/60/90-day plan
description: Propose a learning, contribution and review sequence with realistic milestones.
accomplishes: Propose a learning, contribution and review sequence with realistic milestones. Confirm priorities with the manager rather than inventing authority or targets. Include dependencies, evidence of progress and questions that need agreement.
prompt:
Act as a career writing adviser.

Task: Build a 30/60/90-day plan.

Input context:
- ROLE: [ROLE]
- TEAM GOALS: [TEAM GOALS]
- KNOWN CONTEXT: [KNOWN CONTEXT]
- CONSTRAINTS: [CONSTRAINTS]

Propose a learning, contribution and review sequence with realistic milestones. Confirm priorities with the manager rather than inventing authority or targets. Include dependencies, evidence of progress and questions that need agreement.

Make the output practical, reviewable and appropriate to the supplied context.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## First-90-days outline
First learn the system and stakeholder needs, then deliver one bounded improvement and finally review evidence with the team. Use milestones that fit the actual role and access. Unknown priorities remain questions for the manager. The plan is a discussion draft, not a promised delivery schedule or proof of performance.
